questions.stem: A 3 days old baby’s mother came to pediatric OPD. She share a concern that when ever she breast feed her baby, her baby sleeps comfortably but after every 30 minutes baby wakes up and starts crying. On further evaluation, baby and mother had a good attachment and mother confirms that she breast feed her baby for 5-10 minutes & baby sleeps after that? What is the reason for her baby crying after every 30 minutes ?

options.label: A
options.text: Baby is crying because the diaper is wet

options.label: B
options.text: the quality of the mother’s feed is not good

options.label: C
options.text: Baby is getting only foremilk, the satiety value is missing

options.label: D
options.text: we should rule out neonatal sepsis
